meta.problem:
Jack is enjoying a certain song that is 6 minutes long, and he has been listening to it for 5 minutes now. That means he has listened to 5/6 of the song. Show this fraction on the number line.
What is the fraction in the problem?

hintsPerCorrectStep: Enter 5 in the box.
Enter 6 in the box.
If you want to convert the fraction to a mixed number, click "Convert", if not, simply click on the number line to place your fraction to complete the problem.
Please provide your answer 'No_Value' in the highlighted element.

What is the maximum number of 6/6 that can fit into 5/6?
You can also find this out by dividing the numerator by the denominator, and see how many times 6 fits into 5.
Please enter '0' in the highlighted field.
Convert the improper fraction on the left into a mixed number, and enter the numerator part into this box.
Numerator of the mixed number is the remainder of the division between the numerator and the denominator of the improper fraction!

Imagine the number line being divided into 6 parts.
Think of it this way: 5/6 is only 1 part to the left of "1" or 6/6.
